newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise ahead of wedding season.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise ahead of wedding season.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Wednesday gained on increased buying by bulk consumers ahead of this month's wedding season, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 climbed up by 5/15 rupees to 1,228/1,255 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 5/12 rupees to 1,255/1,312 rupees.
"Restricted arrivals also helped a modest rally in the prices today," one dealer said.
Sugar mill delivery slid by five rupees at 1,150/1,160 rupees amid sluggish demand from outstation buyers. Traders said prices were expected to remain in a narrow band.
